set.body: Outcome: compare the reviewed DeepSeek fixed-input baseline against broader automatic source context and optional manual annotations on frozen questions, without changing production scoring. Preserve source identity/time/scope, keep partial and false-memory facets separate, and test whether new evidence warrants event/person linkage rather than encouraging unsupported resolutions. Freeze input references before inference; retain fixed populations, failures, costs and original outputs. Parent bd-01M5EA1JDF877X4RZPJY6EFJDJ. User authorized proceeding with this comparison. Local experiment and review only; no merge or publication.
set.title: Test context and optional annotation fusion in claim assessment
